body.name: Canonical embedded full-kernel switching certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\) be an ordinary full-kernel identifying collection.  Acquire one full SELECT--RAND--READ protocol \(S_B\) for each distinct \(B\), all assignment labels \(b\in\mathfrak X_B\), and all canonical labelled single-district factors of \(P_b(V\setminus B)\).  Run the complete single-world all-cells translation.  For every \(\alpha=(j,\omega)\in\Omega\), choose the lexicographically first successful protocol--slice--source triple and canonical concrete restriction transcript and create one singleton-ownership record carrying the canonical index of \(\alpha\).  Add an empty-ownership paid-protocol marker for any acquired \(S_B\) unused by those records, remove duplicate markers, and sort lexicographically.  The result is \(E_{\mathbf B}\).
